facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: This trace ran for 20 of 20 slices but cannot be trusted, with only 15.5 within 5 voxels and 9.1 within 2 voxels and a median distance of 28.8 voxels. It is weakest around the click because it is not on the clicked layer, which is visible where the red line meets the yellow dot in the close-up. The fix helped from 1.2 within 5 voxels and a median distance of 33.4 voxels but left large error. A person should check the red line against the papyrus layers in the views of slice 0 and slice 19 at 7.91 micrometres per voxel.
